ops.text: Accuracy differences of this kind carry over into hardware requirements: in an end-to-end compilation study, assuming a lower-threshold streaming hardware decoder instead of matching raises the code distance needed for a $10\times 10$ Fermi-Hubbard Trotter step on a superconducting baseline architecture at $p=10^{-3}$ from 23 to 27 [⟦new.A9⟧].
